# Detailer Shield Insurance

> Specialty business insurance designed specifically for mobile detailers, auto detailers, and pressure-washing operators across the United States.

Detailer Shield Insurance is a specialty insurance brand operated by Contractors Choice Agency, an independent broker headquartered in Chandler, Arizona. We are not a carrier — we place coverage with a vetted panel of A-rated insurers and tailor each policy to the real-world risks detailers face: customer-vehicle damage, ceramic-coating workmanship claims, theft of portable equipment, and slip-and-fall exposure at mobile job sites.

We write policies for solo mobile detailers, multi-truck mobile fleets, fixed-location detail shops, ceramic-coating installers, and residential and commercial pressure-washing operators in all 50 states. Get a quote in minutes or call 844-967-5247 to speak with a licensed agent who knows the detailing trade.

## Primary Services

- [Coverage & Policies](https://www.mobiledetailinsurance.com/coverage.html): Full coverage menu including general liability, garage keepers, tools and equipment, commercial auto, workers compensation, and business owner's policy (BOP) for detailers.
- [Auto Detailing Insurance](https://www.mobiledetailinsurance.com/auto-detailing-insurance.html): Coverage tailored to shop-based and mobile auto detailing businesses, including customer vehicle damage and on-premises liability.
- [Pressure Washing Insurance](https://www.mobiledetailinsurance.com/pressure-washing-insurance.html): Specialty policy for residential and commercial power-washing operators covering property damage, surface harm, and overspray claims.
- [Coverage by State](https://www.mobiledetailinsurance.com/coverage-by-state.html): State-by-state overview of detailing and pressure-washing insurance requirements, minimum limits, and licensing notes.
- [Get a Quote](https://www.mobiledetailinsurance.com/get-a-quote.html): Free, no-obligation online quote request form — most policies bound same-day or next business day.
